title: L2-ARCTIC non-native English manual annotation subset
why_promising: Primary read-speech recordings from 24 non-native English speakers across six L1s. The corpus documents a manually annotated subset of about 150 utterances per speaker with corrected word and phone boundaries plus substitution/deletion/addition error tags, while the remaining corpus phone/word tiers are forced-aligned.
open_question: Obtain the licensed download and isolate only the manually corrected TextGrids/utterances from forced-aligned-only material; capture the corpus license and file-level checksums before core admission. The download is access-form gated, so no observation files were ingested in this pass.
